children.game_version: A rhythmic matching game using lightweight bamboo or plastic sticks to tap patterned beats against a low bench.

seniors.counts: Simplified 2/4 counts at a slow, controlled pace.
seniors.seated_version: Seated securely on a stable chair while practicing lighter pole taps on a low wooden block or lap board.
seniors.standing_version: Supported standing position near a stationary railing with reduced range of motion.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo with minimized arm extension and eliminated high-impact strikes.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Dynamic gripping and swinging of shoulder poles to strike benches or partner poles.
movement_profile.footwork: Stationary or shifting lateral steps around the bench supporting upper body percussion.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Even numbers of dancers arranged on opposite sides of a central bench.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Slight flexion and rotation during striking sequences to mimic agricultural tasks.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low to medium level focused on upper body striking and upright standing positions.
movement_profile.partnering: Coordinated pole striking and cross-beats with opposing dancers.
movement_profile.posture: Upright and active stance facing a wooden bench with feet grounded.

signature_moves.description: Vertical pole strikes simulating seedling insertion into soil.
signature_moves.name: Planting Rice Strike

signature_moves.description: Poles crossed and struck across the bench space with fellow dancers.
signature_moves.name: Diagonal Crossing Beat

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Steady, driven agricultural work rhythm ranging from 2/4 to 5/4 meters.

music_profile.sound_description: Sharp strikes of bamboo shoulder poles against wooden benches interwoven with gongs, drums, and traditional Zhuang folk singing.

basic_steps: Stand on opposite sides of a long wooden bench holding shoulder poles.
Strike the bench surface in synchronization with partner beats.
Cross-strike partner poles in diagonal patterns representing rice planting or threshing.
teaching.formation: Even numbers of dancers standing on both sides of a bench
teaching.level_notes: Intermediate level requiring precise timing and coordination with striking partners.
